text.p: - The new Slovenian arch-bishop France Rode was consecrated on Sunday by his predecessor Alojzij Sustar.
- Over the weekend five people died because of traffic accidents.

- Slovenian Robit Olimpija qualified for the final of the female European Handball Cup after beating Hungarian Vasas in Budapest on Sunday. Olimpija is the first Slovenian team to reach the final for 16 years.

- There are 9,500 applicants still waiting for Slovenian citizenship. After the independence war in 1991 over 40,000 people living in Slovenia were left without permanent residency, Slovenian authorities said.
- Over 10,000 people have already visited the 36th Agriculture and Forestry fair that started on Friday.
- Over the past few years Slovenian Railways has invested some 26.7 million tolars ($174.3 million) in modernising its network.

- Some European Union members are afraid that Slovenia's joining the EU may trigger similar bids from other former Yugoslav republics, said Joachim Bitterlich, foreign and security affairs advisor to German Chancellor Kohl.
